_comment: Scalping V2 Range Scanner — RESEARCH DEFAULTS, not claimed-optimal. PAPER/DECISION-SUPPORT ONLY. Disabled by default. The old fixed-2% scalping config (config/settings.json -> scalping) is preserved and untouched.
_egx_session_phase_comment: EGX Cairo phases: continuous trading 10:00-14:15, closing auction 14:15-14:25 (randomized close ~14:23-14:25). Range quality is evaluated on continuous trading only; new range entries must stop before the auction; auction gaps never invalidate the continuous-session range.
_event_gate_comment: Shadow event-driven data-quality gate (research, PAPER-ONLY, DISABLED). The legacy 60% minute-coverage gate remains the production gate and is preserved unchanged. Enabling this does NOT change any Entry/Stop/Target/RR or the production scanner; it only powers the separate shadow comparison. Only RANGE_CONFIRMED may ever produce a paper opportunity.
